sb-9.name: Baked Avocado Eggs with Bacon
ingredients: Salt, black pepper and finely chopped chives
steps: Halve the avocados and remove the pits. Scoop out a little flesh to make more room for the eggs.
Crack an egg into each avocado half. Place the avocados on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until the egg whites are set. Meanwhile, pan-fry the bacon until crisp, then chop it.
Top the baked eggs with chopped bacon, black pepper and chives, then serve.

sb-10.name: Avocado and Egg Salad
ingredients: Salt, black pepper and chopped parsley
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel them and cut into bite-sized wedges.
Halve and pit the avocados. Score the flesh, scoop it out and cut into large cubes.
Stir the mayonnaise, lime juice, a pinch of salt and black pepper together in a small bowl.
Place the avocado and eggs in a large bowl. Add the dressing and toss gently to avoid breaking the eggs. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

sb-11.name: Garlic Butter Ribeye Steak
ingredients: Kosher salt and coarsely ground black pepper
steps: Pat the steak dry with paper towels. Season both sides evenly with salt and pepper.
Heat a cast-iron pan with a little oil. Sear the steak for about 2–3 minutes on each side until browned.
Add the butter, crushed garlic and rosemary. Tilt the pan and spoon the melted butter over the steak continuously for 1 minute.
Transfer the steak to a plate and rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly to retain its juices.

sb-13.name: Salmon with Creamy Garlic Butter Sauce
steps: Season the salmon with salt and pepper. Pan-sear in a little olive oil for about 3–4 minutes per side until medium, then transfer to a plate.
In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the butter until fragrant. Add the heavy cream, bring to a gentle simmer and reduce the heat until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season with salt, pepper and a few drops of lime juice.
Return the salmon to the sauce for about 1 minute, then serve in a shallow bowl.

sb-14.name: Beef and Asparagus Stir-Fry
ingredients: Salt, pepper and toasted sesame seeds
steps: Wash the asparagus and cut into roughly 5cm lengths. Partially thaw the beef slices.
Cook the garlic in a hot pan until fragrant. Add the asparagus with a little water, blanch in the pan for 2 minutes, then stir-fry over high heat.
Add the beef slices and stir-fry quickly over high heat until cooked, keeping the meat tender.
Add the oyster sauce, salt and pepper. Toss for 1 minute, sprinkle with sesame seeds and turn off the heat.

sb-15.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
ingredients: Minced garlic and finely chopped onion
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan and cook the onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add the chicken stock and bring to a boil. Add the broccoli and simmer for 8–10 minutes until soft.
Use an immersion blender to blend the broccoli in the saucepan until smooth.
Reduce the heat. Slowly stir in the heavy cream and Cheddar until the cheese melts into the soup.

sb-16.name: Pork and Cheese Stuffed Squid
ingredients: 2 wood ear mushrooms, soaked and chopped
Chopped shallots, pepper and fish sauce
steps: Combine the ground pork, wood ear mushrooms, Mozzarella, shallots, 1 tsp fish sauce and pepper.
Fill the squid tubes with the pork mixture without overfilling, then secure the openings with toothpicks.
Steam for 15 minutes until the pork filling is cooked. Then pan-sear in a little butter until the squid is golden and fragrant.
Slice into bite-sized rings and serve with the melted cheese filling.

sb-17.name: Zucchini Noodle Carbonara
ingredients: Minced garlic and coarsely ground black pepper
steps: Use a spiralizer to cut the zucchini into long spaghetti-like strands, discarding the watery core.
Whisk the egg yolks and Parmesan together in a small bowl with a little pepper.
Fry the bacon until crisp and remove some of the excess fat.
Stir-fry the zucchini noodles with the bacon for 1–2 minutes. Turn off the heat, add the egg and cheese mixture and toss quickly so the residual heat sets the sauce without scrambling it.

sb-19.name: Quinoa Vegetable Salad
ingredients: Olive oil, lime juice, salt and parsley
steps: Cook quinoa with water at a ratio of 1 part quinoa to 2 parts water for about 15 minutes, then let it cool.
Wash the cucumber, cherry tomatoes, bell pepper and parsley, then cut as described in the ingredient list.
Combine the quinoa and vegetables in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and lime juice, season with salt and pepper and toss gently.

sb-20.name: Thai Vegetarian Red Curry
ingredients: 1 block tofu, cubed and fried until golden
1.5 tbsp vegetarian Thai red curry paste
Lemongrass, lime leaves, salt and vegetarian seasoning
steps: Cook the crushed lemongrass and red curry paste in a hot saucepan with a little oil until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk and a little water. Add the potato and carrot, bring to a boil, then simmer over medium heat for 12 minutes.
Add the fried tofu and cook for another 5 minutes. Season with salt and vegetarian seasoning.
Lightly crush the lime leaves, add them and cook for 1 minute. Turn off the heat and serve hot with rice or bread.

sb-21.name: Tofu with Garlic Chili Soy Sauce
ingredients: Minced garlic, chopped chili and sliced scallions
steps: Steam the soft tofu for 5 minutes, cut into bite-sized squares and carefully arrange on a plate.
Mix the soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil with the minced garlic and chili in a small bowl.
Bring the sauce to a boil in a pan until slightly thickened, then pour evenly over the tofu.

sb-22.name: Clay Pot Braised King Oyster Mushrooms
ingredients: 250g king oyster mushrooms, sliced into rounds
2 tbsp soy sauce and vegetarian caramel sauce
Chopped leek, green peppercorns and long red chili
steps: Wash the mushrooms in lightly salted water, gently squeeze and cut into rounds about 1cm thick.
Marinate with soy sauce, caramel sauce, sugar and vegetarian seasoning for 15 minutes.
Cook the leek in a clay pot until fragrant. Add the mushrooms and marinade, then braise over low heat with green peppercorns and chili.
Cook until the sauce thickens and the mushrooms absorb the seasoning and turn a rich golden brown.

sb-23.name: Garlic Mushroom Spaghetti
ingredients: 100g button or small king oyster mushrooms, sliced
Salt, black pepper and dried parsley
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water for about 8–10 minutes until al dente. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking water.
Cook the garlic in olive oil in a hot pan until fragrant. Add the mushrooms and stir-fry over high heat until browned.
Add the pasta and reserved cooking water to the pan. Season with salt and crushed black pepper and toss until coated in the sauce.
Sprinkle with dried parsley before serving.

sb-24.name: Southern Vietnamese Vegetarian Sour Soup
ingredients: 50g bean sprouts, elephant ear stalks and okra
Tamarind juice, culantro, rice paddy herb, salt and sugar
steps: Bring water to a boil. Add tamarind juice, pineapple and tomato to develop a naturally sweet and sour broth.
Add the tofu, okra and elephant ear stalks and boil for 3 minutes.
Season with sugar, salt and vegetarian seasoning to balance the characteristic southern Vietnamese sweet and sour flavor.
Add the bean sprouts and chopped culantro and rice paddy herb, then turn off the heat immediately.

sb-25.name: Avocado and Grilled Mushroom Sandwich
ingredients: 100g king oyster mushrooms, sliced and pan-seared
steps: Pan-sear the mushrooms with olive oil, salt and pepper until golden on both sides.
Toast both slices of whole wheat bread until crisp.
Season the mashed avocado with a little salt and lime juice, then spread over one slice of bread.
Layer lettuce, tomato and grilled mushrooms over the avocado. Top with the second slice of bread and cut in half.

sb-26.name: Rainbow Vegetarian Summer Rolls
ingredients: Lettuce, mint and fresh rice vermicelli
Soy sauce and peanut butter dipping sauce
steps: Prepare and arrange all the washed, julienned ingredients on a plate.
Mix peanut butter, soy sauce, sugar and a little warm water until smooth and slightly thick.
Lightly moisten a rice paper wrapper. Layer the lettuce, vermicelli, cucumber, carrot and tofu, then roll tightly.
Arrange on a plate and serve with the peanut and soy dipping sauce.

sb-27.name: Broccoli and Cashew Stir-Fry
ingredients: Minced garlic, salt and vegetarian seasoning
steps: Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 1 minute, then transfer to ice water to retain its color and crunch.
Cook the garlic until fragrant. Add the broccoli and stir-fry over high heat, seasoning with vegetarian oyster sauce, salt and vegetarian seasoning.
Add the roasted cashews and toss for 30 seconds. Turn off the heat to keep the cashews crisp.

sb-28.name: Shiitake Mushroom Oat Porridge
ingredients: Fried leek, cilantro and white pepper
steps: Stir-fry the shiitake mushrooms with leek and a little vegetarian seasoning until fragrant.
Bring the stock to a boil, stir in the oats and simmer for 5–7 minutes until soft and porridge-like.
Add the cooked mushrooms and simmer for another 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and top with crisp fried leek.

sb-29.name: Rosemary Grilled Chicken Breast
ingredients: Salt, black pepper and garlic powder
steps: Prick the chicken breast lightly with a fork. Marinate with olive oil, lime juice, salt, pepper, garlic powder and rosemary for 20 minutes.
Heat a grill pan and cook the chicken over medium heat for about 6–8 minutes per side, until evenly golden and cooked without drying out.
Rest for 3 minutes, then slice diagonally and serve with boiled broccoli.

sb-12.name: Baked Chicken with Mozzarella and Pesto
ingredients: Olive oil, salt, garlic powder and dried oregano
steps: Clean the chicken breasts and make evenly spaced cuts about 1.5cm deep across them.
Season with olive oil, salt and garlic powder. Fill the cuts with pesto, tomato slices and Mozzarella.
Place on a baking tray and sprinkle with dried oregano. Bake at 190°C for 20–25 minutes until the chicken is cooked and golden and the cheese has melted.

sb-18.name: Spinach and Cheese Omelet Roll
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Briefly saute the spinach in a little butter, then transfer to a plate.
Melt butter in the pan and pour in the eggs, spreading them in a thin layer.
While the top is still slightly wet, add the spinach and Cheddar. Roll the omelet and cook for another 1 minute to melt the cheese.

sb-30.name: Cauliflower Fried Rice with Pork
ingredients: Chopped shallots, sliced scallions, soy sauce and oyster sauce
steps: Wash the cauliflower and grate into rice-sized pieces, or pulse in a blender for a few seconds.
Cook the shallots until fragrant. Stir-fry the pork until cooked and season with a little soy sauce and seasoning powder.
Add the grated cauliflower and stir-fry over high heat for 3–4 minutes until it firms up and loses excess moisture.
Pour in the beaten egg and stir so it coats the cauliflower and cooks through. Sprinkle with scallions.

sb-31.name: Shrimp Lettuce Wraps with Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 large head iceberg lettuce, leaves separated
Salt, pepper, minced garlic and olive oil
steps: Season the shrimp with minced garlic, salt and pepper. Pan-sear until pink and cooked, then sprinkle with more pepper.
Mix the Greek yogurt with a little salt, pepper and a few drops of lime juice.
Lay out a lettuce leaf and place avocado slices and shrimp in the center. Drizzle with yogurt sauce and roll tightly.

sb-32.name: Steamed Sea Bass with Ginger and Scallions
ingredients: 3 scallions, cut into lengths and shredded
Sesame oil, salt and cooking wine
steps: Rub the fish with cooking wine and salt and leave for 10 minutes to reduce its fishy aroma.
Place the fish in a shallow dish and scatter half the ginger and scallions over it.
Steam for 12 minutes from when the water starts boiling, until the fish is tender and cooked.
Pour light soy sauce over the hot fish. Top with fresh scallions, cilantro and the remaining ginger, then drizzle with a little heated sesame oil.

sb-33.name: Grilled Pork and Vegetable Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 green or red bell pepper, cut into squares
Fish sauce, honey, minced lemongrass, minced garlic and pepper
steps: Marinate the pork cubes with lemongrass, garlic, honey, fish sauce and pepper for 30 minutes.
Thread pork, bell pepper and onion alternately onto bamboo skewers.
Cook over charcoal, or in an oven or air fryer at 180°C for 15–18 minutes, turning so the pork browns evenly.

sb-34.name: Tuna Salad with Roasted Sesame Dressing
ingredients: 1 can tuna in oil or water, drained
100g mixed salad greens, sprouts and red cabbage
steps: Wash the salad greens, drain thoroughly and arrange on a plate.
Drain the canned tuna and flake with a fork.
Scatter the tuna over the greens and arrange the boiled egg around it.
Drizzle with roasted sesame dressing, toss and serve.

sb-35.name: Steamed Egg Rolls with Pork and Vegetables
ingredients: Chopped scallions, salt, seasoning powder and pepper
steps: Combine the pork paste with wood ear mushrooms, carrot and scallions. Season with seasoning powder and pepper.
Beat the eggs with a little salt and cook very thin omelets in a nonstick pan.
Spread a thin layer of pork filling over the omelet, then roll tightly.
Steam the rolls for 15 minutes until the pork filling is fully cooked. Let cool slightly, then slice into rounds.

sb-36.name: Pan-Fried Beef in Wild Betel Leaves
ingredients: 200g ground beef mixed with a little fatty pork
Minced lemongrass, chopped shallots and black pepper
steps: Mix the ground meat with shallots, lemongrass, a little fish sauce, pepper and 2 finely chopped wild betel leaves.
Place each leaf dark-green side down, add a spoonful of filling and roll tightly. Use the leaf stem to secure the edge.
Place the rolls in a pan with a little oil. Cook over medium heat until the leaves firm up and the meat filling is cooked and fragrant.

sb-37.name: Zucchini Soup with Ground Pork
ingredients: 1 green zucchini, cut into halves or rounds
steps: Cook the chopped scallion whites until fragrant. Stir-fry the pork until partially cooked and season with salt and seasoning powder.
Add enough water, bring to a boil and skim off any foam to keep the broth clear.
Add the zucchini and boil for another 2–3 minutes until just tender. Avoid overcooking it.
Adjust the salt, sprinkle with scallions, cilantro and pepper and ladle into bowls.

sb-38.name: Pan-Seared Chicken with Lime and Lemongrass
ingredients: Minced garlic, chopped shallots and five-spice powder
steps: Marinate the chicken with lemongrass, garlic, shallots, a little five-spice powder, fish sauce and pepper for 20 minutes.
Sear the chicken until golden and crisp outside, then reduce the heat and cook thoroughly inside.
Cook the remaining lemongrass and garlic until fragrant. Add fish sauce and lime juice, simmer until slightly thickened and pour over the chicken.
